phase_name: Retire the nine local branches behind an explicit ordering gate

objectives.description: Gate check A: verdicts recorded in research report, all nine named
Gate check B: re-run all Phase 1 and Phase 2 content assertions
Gate check C: re-run git bundle verify on all nine bundles, re-confirm count nine
Delete all nine branches with git branch -D, capture deleted tip SHAs, confirm they match bundle-manifest.md
Post-deletion verification: exactly three branches remain, HEAD unchanged, remote refs unchanged, bundles still verify, round-trip spot check

deviations.description: Remote refs untouched check expects git branch -r --no-color | wc -l to equal 10
deviations.reason: Actual count before and after deletion is 11, not 10 (plan/research both stated 10; the live remote has 11 refs including origin/HEAD). This is a pre-existing miscount in the plan/research, not a regression: the count is identical before and after deletion (11 == 11), which is the actual safety property being verified. Recorded verbatim rather than silently matching the plan's stated expectation.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — remote ref count is 11 both before and after, not the plan's stated 10; verified unchanged, not the literal expected number)*
